notable_absence.finding: Pure reference catalog - a flat list of Cluster Manager metric names (audit_queue_length, cm_auth_cache_current_items, etc.), each with a version badge and one-line description. The cm_auth_cache_* family (auth cache hits/misses/current/max items, for auth, client_cert, up, bkts, and uuid caches) hints at cbauth's internal caching layer but describes cache statistics, not a service dependency. No dependsOnService/requiresEdition prose on this page. See metrics-reference.json (this batch) for the consolidated dependsOnService finding and the source's explicit exclusion of the Cluster Manager from 'the Services'.
